menus.note: Three glasses of wine €45, alcohol-free pairing €29

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's website (Zenchef or TheFork) or by phone. Online bookings require accepting the restaurant's terms of sale.
cancellation: The cancellation terms are set out when booking online; for questions, call or email contact@latelierdesaugustins.com.
walkIns: The dining room seats about 39, so booking ahead is strongly advised; tables without a booking are not guaranteed.
groups: The restaurant can be booked privately for business or private events. The largest table seats 18, the most it accepts as one party.
